comparator_policy.caused-by: Y because of C. No mechanism or intervention is named in either arm; both assert cause, not the truth of an experimentally established mechanism.
comparator_policy.co-occurring: Y; C preceded or accompanied it; no causation is asserted. Preserve the temporal disjunction and withheld assertion: do not substitute after, while alone, or a claim that C did not cause Y.
comparator_policy.shared_context: These are invented test utterances, not reports about real events. Any one-time glossary is held identical and outside both charged message spans. The complete message itself is counted; no unequal hidden reference ledger, repeated glossary, or omitted payload.

manifest.prediction_interpretation: The proposal predicts token_delta < 0. Report the registered pooled quantity and each form separately; do not pool away a nonnegative form or treat current cost as proof of permanent language unsuitability.
manifest.study_scope: Fresh-input replication of the current token prerequisite across both required causal-assertion and causal-nonassertion strata. This does not test comprehension, causal truth, adoption, or future tokenizers.
manifest.selection: Fixed census of 32 new event/condition contexts in eight new domains, each crossed with both forms. All content, order and wording were frozen before tokenizer import.
manifest.method: Count Ainglish minus complete careful English per pair and registered tokenizer; average within each equal-weight form stratum and across the balanced population; report the least-favourable tokenizer mean with the member span and both headline-tokenizer stratum results.
